description: The north-star test: Stand introduces itself, is interrupted three times and hears one listening noise, then takes closing questions. Lines are timed by how long Stand has spoken, so they land inside the talk whatever its pace.

during.label: on-topic question
during.say: Sorry, quick question. What do you mean when you say it has a goal?

during.label: off-topic question
during.say: Hey, unrelated, but do you know what the weather will be like tomorrow?

during.label: question it cannot answer
during.say: How much is this going to cost, and when can I buy it?

after.label: closing question one
after.say: Can it join a Zoom call today?

after.label: closing question two
after.say: Where does the name Stand come from, again?

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: Thanks, that's all the questions we have.
